preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the permutation N is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of good indices K is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, K in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(permutation) == N for (N, K), permutation in zip(test_cases, permutations))
postconditions.description: Each permutation has a length equal to the specified N for its test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(permutation)) == N for (N, K), permutation in zip(test_cases, permutations))
postconditions.description: Each permutation contains N distinct elements.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i, x in enumerate(permutation, 1) if x % i == 0) == K for (N, K), permutation in zip(test_cases, permutations))
postconditions.description: Each permutation has exactly K good indices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= N for x in permutation) for permutation in permutations)
postconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(permutation == '-1' for (N, K), permutation in zip(test_cases, permutations) if not any(sum(1 for i, x in enumerate(permutation, 1) if x % i == 0) == K for permutation in generate_permutations(N, K)))
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output '-1'.
